title: Prime Minister interacts with MPs from BRICS nations during the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in New Delhi
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today had a wonderful interaction with MPs  from BRICS nations during the ongoing 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum 2026 being held in New Delhi. During the interaction, the Prime Minister and visiting parliamentary delegates exchanged perspectives on a wide range of issues. The Prime Minister shared on X: "Had a wonderful interaction with MPs from BRICS nations during the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum 2026 being held in Delhi. We exchanged perspectives on a wide range of issues." Had a wonderful interaction with MPs from BRICS nations during the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum 2026 being held in Delhi. We exchanged perspectives on a wide range of issues. https://t.co/a1aG8P7vny — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 26, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/PRK
